SELECT COUNT(1) CNT,'CustomerAccountFinancialProduct' as tables  FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT,'CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_grp' as tables FROM (SELECT CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct 
GROUP by CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,ProductId
,FinancialProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,UsageCategoryId
,CommitmentId
,FcbsApplication
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId) A;

SELECT CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,ProductId
,FinancialProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,UsageCategoryId
,CommitmentId
,FcbsApplication
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
INTO bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_REMDUP_20230805
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
GROUP by CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,ProductId
,FinancialProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,UsageCategoryId
,CommitmentId
,FcbsApplication
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId;


RENAME OBJECT BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct TO CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_BU_20230805;

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT, 'CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_BU' as tables FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_BU_20230805;

RENAME OBJECT BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_REMDUP_20230805 TO CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT, 'CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_REMDUP' as tables FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;




SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CustomerAccountFinancialProduct' AND TABLE_SCHEMA = 'bnkm'





SELECT BranchId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' GROUP BY BranchId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode





--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE   with pipeline alternative

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId,ProductID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId,PeriodStartDate,PeriodEndDate ORDER BY CustomerAccountId DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* INTO Bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_WITH_DUP_20230805  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_WITH_DUP_20230805
--3557541

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
--3557541


--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;



--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
[EmployerId]
,[EmployerName]
,[LocationId]
,[EmployerTelephoneNumber]

,[EmployerUsFederalEmployerId]
,[PartyId]
,[DunsNumber]
,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary]
,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters]
,[DunBradstreetBranch]
,[DunBradstreetDivision]
,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary]
,[DunBradstreetParent]
,[DunBradstreetUltimate]
,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate]
,[AnzsicClassCode]
,[SectorCode]
,[SicIndustryCode]
,[SmeClassCode]
,[Subsector]
,[EmployerAddress1]
,[EmployerAddress2]
,[EmployerAddress3]
,[EmployerAddress4]
,[CityId]
,[StateId]
,[ZipCode]
,[Country]
,[EmployerCodeOccupationLegal]
,[BusinessNature]
,[EmployerAddressLine1]
,[EmployerAddressLine2]
,[EmployerAddressLine3]
,[EmployerAddressLine4]
,[EmployerCodeTopCompany]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[TaskRunId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[InsertDttm]

FROM Bnkm.Employer_WITH_DUP_20230613 -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records
WHERE RN = 1;


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT EmployerId, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.Employer -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY EmployerId, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.Employer_WITH_DUP_20230613
